connectionSpecification.description: Reads the AppLovin advertiser (Axon) report and the MAX revenue report day by day.

api_key.description: Report Key of the AppLovin account, listed on the Keys page of the dashboard. AppLovin accepts it only as the api_key query parameter; the connector never logs request URLs and removes the key from error messages.
api_key.title: Report Key

lookback_days.description: Days before the saved day an incremental read requests again, so revenue and cohort metrics that keep changing after the day are picked up. Default 3.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

start_date.description: First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, to read. The API serves only the last 45 days; an earlier day starts at the oldest day it serves.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: AppLovin Source Spec
